_about: The Capelli Institute catalog. ONE source of truth for every book, edition, and lecture. Pages are generated from this file (tools/build-pages.py) and assets/data/catalog.js is derived from it for the in-page edition selector. Add a title here, run the generator, and the site has a product page. Commerce fields (price, sku, isbn, buyUrl, stock) are structured so a checkout can be attached later without a redesign. All copy below is transcribed from Sam Capelli's own cover art and sheets; nothing is invented. Fields set to null are awaiting the client.

author._note: COVER-CONTEXT NAME ONLY. Every cover says 'Dr.'; his email signature says 'Prof.' Open question Q17 for Sam. Do not use the title outside product/book contexts.

items.title: The Architecture of Human Choice
items.subtitle: Understanding the Mind Before the Action
items.synopsis: This lecture explores how awareness, perception, emotion, and behavior interact in the moment of choice. It provides a foundation for understanding human decision-making and how disciplined awareness creates a different outcome.
items.excerpt: When we talk about choice, most people believe they are choosing. But what is actually happening is a reaction based on perception, emotion, and conditioning. The first step is awareness. If you are not aware of what is happening inside you, then you are not choosing. You are reacting. And reaction is not freedom. Reaction is conditioning…
